summary: Iteration 29 — Batch tested CP67 points 10-15 (bulk reprocess force-credit fallback, JSON bill upload endpoint, WhatsApp force-credit toggle, nightly Fundle sync scheduler, one-time legacy-154 sync, RWA+Office QR codes). 17/17 backend pytest tests PASS. Frontend: FundleSync page, AppSettings toggle, and Bulk Reprocess dialog all verified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~7637 lines — continues to exceed 700-line guideline. Consider extracting Fundle sync (line 6045+), scheduler (line 7500+), and QR code endpoints into separate modules.

GET /api/consumer/app-settings returns wrapped body {settings: {...}} while GET /api/admin/app-settings returns flat body — inconsistent response envelope; consumer UI has to unwrap. Non-blocking but worth aligning.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 4 flows: FundleSync render + start-legacy-sync + run-nightly + toast, AppSettings toggle present, Bulk Reprocess dialog opens with force-on-reject checked by default)

seed_data_creation: Created 2 test bills via /api/consumer/bills/upload-base64 (data-URL + raw base64) and 1 via multipart upload for regression. Created and cleaned-up 1 new test consumer (random 10-digit phone) for SRC_RWA source-capture verification. auto_force_credit_on_fundle_reject app-setting was toggled true then restored to original value.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Point 15 QR image field is 'image_base64' (not 'qr_image'). Consumer verify-otp response token key is 'token' (not 'access_token'). Consumer /app-settings body wraps settings under 'settings' key. Admin bill list route is /api/bills (not /api/admin/bills). Consumer users with source filter is /api/users?source=... (not /api/admin/users which returns admin users only). Admin routes in frontend use /fundle-sync, /app-settings, /bills (no /admin/ prefix). Legacy-154 sync completes almost instantly with all 154 marked 'failed' because local DB has none of those users — this is the correct/expected behaviour per problem statement.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs. All 6 CP67 batch points verified working: (10) bulk-reprocess dry-run returns candidates and honours force_credit_on_fundle_reject; UI checkbox default-checked. (11) /bills/upload-base64 accepts both data:URL and raw base64, rejects invalid input with 400. (12) auto_force_credit_on_fundle_reject toggle persists via admin PUT and is exposed via consumer GET. (13) APScheduler running ('Scheduler started — nightly Fundle sync at 1:00 AM IST'); /admin/sync/nightly/run-now queues job; /admin/sync/jobs lists 'nightly_registration_sync'. (14) /admin/sync/legacy-154 returns job_id + total=154; job progresses and completes with counters {processed,registered,already,failed,bills_synced,bills_failed}. FundleSync UI renders and buttons work. (15) /api/qr-links includes SRC_RWA + SRC_OFFICE; QR0124010 and QR0124011 generate valid base64 PNG; first_touch_source=SRC_RWA captured on new-user verify-otp and queryable via /api/users?source=SRC_RWA. Regression: /api/bills, /admin/campaigns, /admin/app-settings, /consumer/campaigns/active, and multipart /consumer/bills/upload all still work.
